messages.subject: mod_R with XCode 4/Mac OS X Lion
parts:
Hi!

I try to install rapache on my machine (Mac OS X Lion, XCode 4, R
2.13.1). Make tries to compile mod_R but breaks with this error:

---

Compiling mod_R

/Applications/XAMPP/xamppfiles/bin/apxs -I/Library/Frameworks/
R.framework/Resources/include -I/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/
Resources/include/x86_64 -I/Users/mmarbach/Downloads/rapache-1.1.14/
libapreq2/include -I/Applications/XAMPP/xamppfiles/include -c
mod_R.c -F/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/.. -framework R -L/Users/
mmarbach/Downloads/rapache-1.1.14/libapreq2/library/.libs -lapreq2
Use of assignment to $[ is deprecated at /Applications/XAMPP/
xamppfiles/bin/apxs line 86.
/Applications/XAMPP/xamppfiles/build/libtool --silent --mode=compile
gcc -prefer-pic -I/Applications/XAMPP/xamppfiles/include -L/
Applications/XAMPP/xamppfiles/lib -mmacosx-version-min=10.4 -arch i386
-arch ppc -DDARWIN -DSIGPROCMASK_SETS_THREAD_MASK -no-cpp-precomp -I/
Applications/XAMPP/xamppfiles/include -I/Applications/XAMPP/
xamppfiles/include -I/Applications/XAMPP/xamppfiles/include -I/
Applications/XAMPP/xamppfiles/include -I/Library/Frameworks/
R.framework/Resources/include -I/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/
Resources/include/x86_64 -I/Users/mmarbach/Downloads/rapache-1.1.14/
libapreq2/include -I/Applications/XAMPP/xamppfiles/include -c -o
mod_R.lo mod_R.c && touch mod_R.slo
llvm-gcc-4.2: error trying to exec '/usr/bin/../llvm-gcc-4.2/bin/
powerpc-apple-darwin11-llvm-gcc-4.2': execvp: No such file or
directory
lipo: can't figure out the architecture type of: /var/folders/pz/
7hlpbvb53zz90zfrnd_z09ww0000gn/T//ccrEL00Z.out
apxs:Error: Command failed with rc=65536
.
make: *** [mod_R.so] Error 1

-----

I think the problem is that XCode 4 doesn't support ppc anymore but
the rapache make is still looking for it. Is there a way to tell make
not to compile for ppc?

Thx!
Moritz

Well, rApache pulls information from both the apache build system and
the R build system, so one of those two systems is giving bad
information. I would focus resolving those build systems first before
modifying rApache's make file.
